ResourceGrpID.description: A code uniquely identifies a Resource Group.  Cannot be blank. This is used as a foreign key in other files and may be used in displays/reports where space for the full description is limited.

Description.description: Long description of the Resource Group.

Inactive.description:
Flag which indicates if the Resource Group is considered "Inactive".  For historical purposed, and data integrity, it is difficult to delete a ResourceGroup that has been used for production.  Instead, it is set to Inactive = YES.
This flag will be used to exclude Resource Groups from certain searches and reports.
Resource Groups where Inactive=yes are treated as deleted, but remain in the table to maintain database integrity.

JCDept.description: The Key ID of the Home Department for this Resource Group.  This is a foreign key to the JCDept table.

SetupBurRate.description: Default burden rate for Setup time.

QProdBurRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for production in the Resource Group.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

QSetupBurRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for setup in the Resource Group.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

ResourceType.description: For scheduling purposes a Resource Group can be a Standard resource (S), Additional resource (D), or Auxiliary resource (X).  Standard resources use capacity when scheduled in a finite capacity workcenter.  An Auxiliary Resource can be used in production by  any operation concurrently with a Standard resource, but it does not use capacity.  This is significant for scheduling work to the machine.  Also, an Auxiliary resources does not have to be available for an entire operation.  Additional resources can be added to an Operation, they do use capacity and need to be available for the entire operation.

InputWhse.description: Indicates a warehouse  in which parts are staged for consumption by the Resource Group.  This must be valid in the Warehouse table.

OutputWhse.description: Defines a warehouse for the output of a Resource Group.  This must be valid in the Warehouse table.

SysRowID.description: Unique identifier for this row. The value is a GUID.

CharacteristicAttrClassID.description: ID of related Attribute Class, the class must be of type Characteristics.

CharacteristicAttributeSetID.description: The unique identifier of the related Dynamic Attribute Set.

whereClause.description: An expression used to filter the rows. Can be left blank for all rows.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Leave as zero for no maximum.

morePages.description: Whether there are more pages of rows available.

ResourceGrpID.description: A code uniquely identifies a Resource Group.  Cannot be blank. This is used as a foreign key in other files and may be used in displays/reports where space for the full description is limited.

Description.description: Long description of the Resource Group.

CalendarID.description: Identifies the production calendar for this Resource Group.   If this equals "", then the ProdCal record is the Company Level production calendar.

Inactive.description:
Flag which indicates if the Resource Group is considered "Inactive".  For historical purposed, and data integrity, it is difficult to delete a ResourceGroup that has been used for production.  Instead, it is set to Inactive = YES.
This flag will be used to exclude Resource Groups from certain searches and reports.
Resource Groups where Inactive=yes are treated as deleted, but remain in the table to maintain database integrity.

AllowManualOverride.description: If it is Finite Resource Group, and this is true, then the user will be allow to overload this Resource Group from using the scheduling tools.

FiniteHorizon.description: The number of days out this Resource Group will be scheduled finitely.  Production capacity requirements past this day are treated as infinite.

NumberOfMachines.description:
The number of Resources in this Resource Group. The number of Resources X HrsPerMachine = Capacity.
A Resource Group with zero Resources is considered infinite capacity.

SchMachine.description: Number of Resources that one operation runs on at a time within this Resource Group.  This affects how much of the total daily Resource Group capacity is used up per operation.  If Resource Group has 4  Resource, 8 hour a day, and SchMachine = 2.  An operation will schedule up to 16 hours per day.   This is used as a default to the JobOper.Machines field.

BurdenType.description: Indicates if the BurdenRate fields are either a flat hourly dollar rate or a percentage of LaborRate. Default is Hourly dollar rate.   Set to "F" (flat) or "P" (percent).

MoveHours.description: The number of hours of delay that occurs when an operation leaves this Resource Group before the next operation can begin in a different Resource Group.

JCDept.description: The Key ID of the Home Department for this Resource Group.  This is a foreign key to the JCDept table.

QueHours.description: Queue Time.  The number of hours of delay that occurs when an operation enters this Resource Group before it can begin. (The opposite of MoveHours)

OpCode.description: Establishes the default operation used when referencing this Resource Group.  This is optional, but if entered it must be valid in the OpMaster.

SetupBurRate.description: Default burden rate for Setup time.

SetupLabRate.description: Default labor rate for setup time.

QProdBurRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for production in the Resource Group.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

QProdLabRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for production on the Resource.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

QSetupBurRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for setup in the Resource Group.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

QSetupLabRate.description:
Quoting burden rate for setup in the Resource Group.
Based on QBurdenType this may be an hourly rate or a percentage.

SplitBurden.description: Indicates if burden hours are split out among employees when multiple employees work simultaneously on the same job operation within this Resource Group.  This feature is only applicable to Data Collection.  Manual Labor Entry does not split the burden hours. The opposite is that each employee should have their burden hours = labor hours. This situation would occur in Resource Groups that actually have "people" as machines, such as an assembly or welding center where multiple people work on the same job.

ProdCrewSize.description: Defines the default crew size for work done in this Resource Group.   The number of people it physically takes to run the machine. This should not be confused with scheduled number of machines, which squeezes the schedule time. The crew size is a multiplier used in calculation of Production labor hours on operations.

SetupCrewSize.description: Defines the default setup crew size for work done in this Resource Group.  The number of people it physically takes to setup the Resource.  This should not be confused with scheduled number of machines, which squeezes the schedule time.  The crew size is a multiplier  used in calculation of setup labor hours for an operation.

OpStdID.description: Defines a default Operation standard master ID for this Resource Group.  If entered then this along with the ResourceGrpID, OpCode must be valid in the OpStd master file.

ReloadNum.description: lib/Reloader.w program increments and assigns it to Joboper.ReloadNum as it processes JobOper records. It is used to prevent redundant reads during the For Each loop.

ReloadStatus.description: A  recovery flag which indicates the status of the Reload process for this Resource Group.  Values; Blank or "Started".

QBurdenType.description: Indicates if the Quote Burden Rate fields are either a flat hourly dollar rate or a percentage of Quote LaborRate.  Default is Hourly dollar rate.  Set to "F" (flat) or "P" (percent).

BurdenEQLabor.description: Indicates if burden hours should equal Labor Hours for work reported within this Resource Group.  This feature is only applicable to Data Collection.  This is intended to be used where an employee jumps between multiple job operations without clock in/out (for efficiency purposes).  Example: Employee works on 4 operations for 8am - 1200.  They clock out of all 4 at 12.  Each transaction is given 1hr of labor.  If this is checked then each transaction will also have 1hr of burden.  Otherwise they will have 4 hrs for a total of 16 burden hrs.

SplitOperations.description: Used for scheduling.  If YES then a single operation in this Resoure Group can be split across multiple Resources.

ResourceType.description: For scheduling purposes a Resource Group can be a Standard resource (S), Additional resource (D), or Auxiliary resource (X).  Standard resources use capacity when scheduled in a finite capacity workcenter.  An Auxiliary Resource can be used in production by  any operation concurrently with a Standard resource, but it does not use capacity.  This is significant for scheduling work to the machine.  Also, an Auxiliary resources does not have to be available for an entire operation.  Additional resources can be added to an Operation, they do use capacity and need to be available for the entire operation.

InputWhse.description: Indicates a warehouse  in which parts are staged for consumption by the Resource Group.  This must be valid in the Warehouse table.

InputBinNum.description: Indicates a warehouse bin  in which parts are staged for consumption by the Resource Group.  It  must be valid in the WhseBin table.

OutputWhse.description: Defines a warehouse for the output of a Resource Group.  This must be valid in the Warehouse table.

OutputBinNum.description: Defines a warehouse bin for the output of a Resource Group.  It  must be valid in the WhseBin table.

BackflushWhse.description: Defines a warehouse for backflushing material of a Resource Group.  This must be valid in the Warehouse table.   Used with the InputWhse/InputBin.  If a JobMtl record is set to be backflushed, the the JobMtl is linked to a JobOper, and the Resource Group for the JobOper has a backflush warehouse, then the material will be backflushed from that warehouse when there is not a positive quantity available for the Resource Group InputWhse/Input Bin.

BackflushBinNum.description: Defines a warehouse bin for backflushing for the Resource Group.  It  must be valid in the WhseBin table.

InformOverload.description: Indicates that Resource Group is visible in Overload Informer.

MinOverloadPerc.description: The minimum overload threshold before a day shows up in the Overload Informer.

BackflushEmpID.description: Is the Employee ID which will be defaulted into LaborDtl records which get created through backflushing.  If this field is blank, then the Employee ID on the LaborDtl record causing the backflush process to be triggered will be used.

SubContract.description: This flags the Resource Group as being a "SubContract" or an "Internal".  This will determine the default when adding an operation to a BOM, Job, or Quote.

AutoMove.description: To toggle on and off the automove flag for a Resource Group.  When false , the default is to generate a move request. When true the default is to not generate a move request. These defaults can be seen when entering a quantity and ending an activity in labor entry.

UseEstimates.description: Indicates if hours are split out using estimate values when working  on multiple  job operations.

DailyProdQty.description: Daily Production Qty: The production quantity developed to satisfy demand.  The cell is designed to produce at that quantity for a given time frame (daily).

BillLaborRate.description: Field Service - Labor rate used for time on an operation.  Time per hour per technician.

DailyProdRate.description: The Daily Prod rate contains the rate required to make 1. This is multiplied with the mfg qty of the job to get the total production qty. This total is then compared to the resource's daily production quantity .   Once the production limit for a resource  has been reached, the Resource has been consumed for that day.

TrkProdAct.description: Flag to indicate whether to track production activity of the resource group.

SetShopLoad.description: When the capcity changes for a resourceGroup (in Resource Group Entry), this flag is set to true to indicate that Generate Shop Capacity process needs to be run to update the ShopLoad records.  This used to be performed within ResourceGroupEntry but for performance reasons it is being moved to the Generate Shop Capacity process
